newsitem.title: USA: No apology from Clinton for fundraising.
newsitem.headline: No apology from Clinton for fundraising.

text.p: An unapologetic President Clinton attended a dinner Thursday night that raised $4 million for the Democratic Party, saying he only regretted the event wasn't held in the Lincoln bedroom of the White House.

Clinton, broadly criticised for inviting political contributors to the White House last year for coffee meetings and, in some cases, letting big donors sleep in the Lincoln bedroom, thanked those who attended the black tie gala for the party.
"I hope you're here tonight because you like politics and I hope you never stop liking politics," Clinton told the crowd of some 2,500 contributors at the D.C. Armory.
"I wish we could have had this event tonight in the Lincoln bedroom, but we did not have enough coffee in the White House," he said to the cheers of the party faithful.
White House Press Secretary Mike McCurry said Clinton had no reservations about attending the fund raiser. "The party's in debt and we intend to help the party retire the debt," he said.
